_comment: Copy to base/form.json (gitignored). What browser/forms fills into Ashby, Greenhouse and Lever forms without a model. Leave a value empty to have that field left for the agent. Visa / sponsorship / work-authorisation questions are never filled from here, whatever you put.

corrections._comment: Exact question label (case and punctuation ignored) to what you set it to. Written by the correction loop when you fix a field before submitting; `was` is what the form held (Jobright's autofill, usually). On the next form that asks the same question the value goes over whatever autofill put there. Fills radios, dropdowns and text, never a textarea or a visa question. A plain string is accepted too.
